title: Reward Tilting via Semantic Noising
abstract: arXiv:2611.29318v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steering a generative model toward a desired property typically requires separate fine-tuning for each reward or additional computation during sampling. We propose semantic noising, which conditions generation on a noisy semantic representation of the data. The resulting posteriors correspond to exponential tilts by linear-quadratic rewards in semantic space, allowing a single model to support objectives and strengths chosen after training. A conditional generator can be trained to approximate these posteriors directly, while models that generate semantic representations by diffusion provide analytic tilted denoisers for the same family of rewards. We illustrate semantic noising in three settings. An autoregressive molecular generator trained with semantic noising controls properties individually and jointly, with a better reward--KL trade-off than property-conditioned models. On ImageNet, a joint diffusion model of images and their CLIP

translated_title: 通过语义加噪实现奖励倾斜
translated_abstract: 将生成模型引导至期望属性通常需要对每个奖励进行单独微调，或在采样过程中进行额外计算。我们提出了语义加噪方法，该方法将生成过程条件化于数据的含噪语义表示之上。由此得到的后验分布对应于语义空间中由线性-二次奖励引起的指数倾斜，使得单一模型能够支持在训练之后才选定的目标和强度。可以训练一个条件生成器来直接逼近这些后验分布，而通过扩散过程生成语义表示的模型则为同一类奖励提供解析式的倾斜去噪器。我们在三个场景中展示了语义加噪的应用。一个采用语义加噪训练的自回归分子生成器能够单独或联合地控制分子属性，其奖励-KL权衡优于属性条件化模型。在ImageNet上，一个对图像及其CLIP语义表示进行联合建模的扩散模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“语义加噪”方法，通过在数据的含噪语义表示上条件化生成，使单一模型能够支持训练后任选的线性-二次奖励倾斜目标，免去了针对每个奖励单独微调的需求，并在分子生成与图像生成任务中取得了更优的奖励-KL权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "semantic noising," which conditions generation on noisy semantic representations so that a single trained model can support arbitrary post-hoc linear-quadratic reward tilts, achieving better reward-KL trade-offs than property-conditioned models in molecular and image generation tasks.
